sections.title: Sandia National Labs Solves PDEs on Neuromorphic Hardware — HPC's Energy Efficiency Inflection
sections.lead: Sandia National Laboratories successfully performed physics simulations based on partial differential equations (PDEs) using brain-inspired neuromorphic hardware, publishing the results in Nature Machine Intelligence.

sections.title: DOE Genesis/SYNAPS-I — Petabyte Science Data Interpreted in Real Time
sections.lead: A public-private consortium led by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory built an ML pipeline that interprets petabytes of X-ray and neutron scattering data on the fly.

sections.title: China's Big Three Multimodal Releases — Seedance 2.0, Kling 3.0, Qwen 3.5
sections.lead: ByteDance, Kuaishou, and Alibaba released a quad-modal video model, 4K video generation, and a math/coding open-weight model in rapid succession.

sections.title: OpenAI Launches Ads and Frontier vs. Anthropic Holds No-Ads Line and Opens Free Tier
sections.lead: OpenAI concretized a dual revenue structure with advertising and an enterprise agent platform, while Anthropic reaffirmed its no-ads principle and significantly expanded free-plan capabilities.

sections.title: Canada-Germany Sovereign Technology Alliance — First Official Democratic AI Governance Model
sections.lead: Canada and Germany signed an AI joint declaration and launched an alliance to build sovereign AI capabilities.
